receipt: BASIS: memory.max of the record leaf by W = the MEASURED per-worker maxrss x W x 1.3 page-rounded (the nominal per-worker form); the labeled 2x raise-once knob; W 8 PROBE at 2x
basis_kind: MEASURED (the second-host smoke leaf smoke_leaf: per-worker maxrss = max VmHWM over the pysecdec_cpuworker pids of both legs, sampled every 0.2 s; GNU time maxrss and the leaf memory.peak beside)

per_worker_maxrss.rule: max VmHWM over the pysecdec_cpuworker pids of both legs (the sampler, 0.2 s)

driver_maxrss.rule: max VmHWM over the python3 -m pySecDec.disteval driver pids of both legs

formula_nominal: memory_max_bytes(W) = page_up(1.3 x W x per_worker_maxrss_B) (the nominal per-worker form); PROBE (W 8): 2 x; raise_once = 2 x memory_max_bytes
formula_used: memory_max_bytes(W) = page_up(1.3 x (driver_maxrss_B + W x per_worker_maxrss_B)) -- the corrected form, used because the disteval workers are ~6 MB C++ processes and the python driver carries ~90 MB, so the per-worker formula alone leaves no room for the driver and would OOM at spawn (driver_fits_in_formula_headroom False); the nominal figure can be forced by the caller, labeled
headroom_note: both figures are listed per W; the leaf memory.peak of the W=2 smoke (the cgroup total: driver + 2 workers + bash/time/sampler) is beside as the cross-check

checkpoint_plan.unit: a CHUNK = a group of sectors (kernels sector_<n>_order_<k> filtered into a copy of the disteval data dir; stage_chunks.py); stage A unchunked (one result), stages B and C chunked by CHUNK_SECTORS (default 12 sectors -> 28 chunks of the 332 sectors); each chunk = disteval result.json + time.txt + rc + DONE under work/<stamp>/stage_<X>/chunks/chunk_NNN/
checkpoint_plan.resume: the identical line with --resume: chunks with a DONE marker are skipped; a stage with STAGE_DONE is skipped; the assembled RESULT_<stage>.json is rebuilt from the chunk files
checkpoint_plan.lost_on_a_stop: the chunk in flight (its lattice sequence restarts from --points; the shifts are seeded RandomState(0) per kernel, disteval.py line 556)
order_of_stages: A: --points 1e4 --shifts 32 --epsrel EPSREL_A (1e-4) unchunked (fast; gives the per-order magnitudes for the chunk epsabs of B and C)
B: --points 1e5 --shifts 32 --epsrel EPSREL_B (1e-6) chunked; epsabs per chunk = EPSREL_B x |order value from A| / sqrt(n_chunks)
C: the second integrator = the median-lattice rule --lattice-candidates 11 (a different lattice construction, same kernel library) at the B targets, chunked
checkpoint_plan.digits: quoted only from the compare (per order: min over pairs of agreed digits and over the bars), never from one run
